description_en: Updates an RTC cloud recording task
name: UpdateRtcCloudRecording

parameters.help_en: The task ID. This ID is returned by StartRtcCloudRecording. Only tasks in the running or abnormal state can be updated
parameters.help_zh: 任务id。由 StartRtcCloudRecording 返回，只支持更新运行中或异常中的任务
parameters.name: task_id

fields.help_en:
The video input stream type of the UserId. This parameter takes effect only when the video stream is subscribed (StreamType=2). Valid values:

0: camera. (Default)

1: screen sharing
fields.help_zh:
该UserId的视频输入流类型，仅针对订阅视频流时（StreamType=2）有效。取值：

0：摄像头。（默认值）

1：屏幕共享
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The media type of the subscribed UserId. Valid values:

0: original stream, which includes both audio and video. (Default)

1: audio-only stream.

2: video-only stream
fields.help_zh:
订阅的UserId的媒体类型。取值：

0：原始流，即包括音频和视频。（默认值）

1：仅音频流。

2：仅视频流
fields.name: stream_type

fields.help_en:
The list of subscribed UserId entries. In single-stream recording mode, each UserId is recorded separately. In stream mixing recording mode, the audio and video of all UserIds are mixed into a single set of audio and video.

The array supports a maximum of 17 elements
fields.help_zh:
订阅的UserId信息列表，单流录制模式下，会对其中每个UserId分别进行录制；混流录制模式下，会将所有UserId的音视频混合到一组音视频中。

数组内最多支持17个元素
fields.name: subscribe_user_id_list

parameters.help_zh: 更新后的订阅相关参数
parameters.name: subscribe_params

fields.help_en:
The display mode for the output. Valid values:
0: crop. (Default)
1: scale and display with black borders
fields.help_zh:
画面输出时的显示模式。取值：
0：裁剪。（默认值）
1：缩放并显示黑底
fields.name: render_mode

fields.help_en: The URL of the background image. The maximum length is 2048 characters
fields.help_zh: 背景图URL，最大长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The global background image for stream mixing
fields.name: mix_background

fields.help_en: The pane height as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0, 1]. (Default: 0)
fields.help_zh: 窗格高度，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: height

fields.help_en:
The video input stream type of the UserId. This parameter is invalid if UserId is not specified. Valid values:
0: camera. (Default)
1: screen sharing.

The combination of UserId and SourceType specified here must be included in SubscribeUserIdList
fields.help_zh:
该UserId的视频输入流类型。不填写UserId时，此处设置SourceType无效。取值：
0：摄像头。（默认值）
1：屏幕共享。

这里设置的UserId与SourceType的组合必须包含在SubscribeUserIdList中
fields.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The display mode for the sub-pane output. Valid values:
0: crop. (Default)
1: scale and display with black borders
fields.help_zh:
子画面输出时的显示模式。取值：
0：裁剪。（默认值）
1：缩放并显示黑底
fields.name: render_mode

fields.help_en: The URL of the background image. The maximum length is 2048 characters
fields.help_zh: 背景图URL，最大长度不超过2048个字符
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The sub-pane background image. When a user turns off the camera, has not started stream ingest after joining, or leaves the channel midway, the corresponding image is displayed at the layout position
fields.help_zh: 子画面背景图，当用户关闭摄像头、或入会后未推流、或入会后中途离会时，会在布局位置填充为对应的图片
fields.name: sub_background

fields.help_en:
The UserId corresponding to this window.
If UserId is not specified, windows are filled in the order in which subscribed users join the channel.
The combination of UserId and SourceType specified here must be included in SubscribeUserIdList.
Audio-only streams cannot be added to the layout
fields.help_zh:
该窗口对应的UserId。
不设置UserId时，会按照订阅的用户进入频道的顺序依次填入窗口。
这里设置的UserId与SourceType的组合必须包含在SubscribeUserIdList中。
订阅纯音频流是不能加入到布局中的
fields.name: user_id

fields.help_en: The pane width as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0, 1]. (Default: 0)
fields.help_zh: 窗格宽度，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: width

fields.help_en: The X coordinate as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0, 1]. (Default: 0)
fields.help_zh: 坐标X，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: x

fields.help_en: The Y coordinate as a normalized percentage. The value must be in the range of [0, 1]. (Default: 0)
fields.help_zh: 坐标Y，归一化百分比。取值范围须在[0,1]内。(默认为0)
fields.name: y

fields.help_en: The stacking order. 0 is the bottom layer, layer 1 is above layer 0, and so on. (Default: 0)
fields.help_zh: 叠放顺序，0为最底层，1层在0层之上，以此类推。(默认为0)
fields.name: z_order

fields.help_en: The window layout information of the subscribed users. Only UserIds with layout information configured are placed in the output. This parameter is required in stream mixing mode when recording non-audio-only files
fields.help_zh: 用于指定订阅的用户的窗口布局信息，只有设置了布局信息的UserId，才会被放到画面中。混流模式且录制非纯音频文件时必填
fields.name: user_panes

parameters.help_en: The updated layout parameters. Leave this parameter empty in single-stream recording mode. This parameter is required in stream mixing recording mode when the transcoding output is not audio-only
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的布局相关参数，单流录制模式下不填，混流录制模式下非纯音频转码时必填
parameters.name: mix_layout_params
